Sterilised cats have different requirements compared to cats that haven't been neutered or spayed. That's why ROYAL CANIN® Sterilised in Gravy is specially formulated with the nutritional needs of your neutered adult cat in mind. With a controlled energy content and a moderate level of fat, ROYAL CANIN® Sterilised in Gravy helps to limit the chances of your cat gaining an excess weight; particularly when served in adequate daily rations. ROYAL CANIN® Sterilised in Gravy is formulated to match the optimal nutritional profile instinctively preferred by adult cats - to ensure that they consume the nutrients they need to maintain good overall health. ROYAL CANIN® Sterilised in Gravy also contains a carefully-considered balance of minerals that helps to support the health of your cat's urinary system. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
